title: What is past cannot be undone
literal_meaning: No lamentation for what has gone.
explanation: The maxim urges someone to stop dwelling on an irreversible event and attend to what can still be done. It need not mean forgetting lessons or dismissing grief.
meaning_odia: ଯାହା ଘଟିସାରିଛି ଓ ଫେରାଇ ହେବ ନାହିଁ, ତାହାକୁ ନେଇ କେବଳ ଅନୁତାପରେ ଅଟକି ନରହିବା। ଶିଖିବା ଓ ଆଗର କାମ କରିବାକୁ ମନ ଦେବା।
usage_example: After missing an application deadline, someone prepares carefully for the next opportunity. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary explicitly labels this a Sanskrit proverb recorded in Odia. It is not a rule about how long someone should grieve.
